title: biger notch and breeze rod
description: This texture pack for Minecraft makes the Enchanted Golden Apple and Breeze Rod appear 4x larger on the ground and slightly tilted, making them easier to spot and more visually appealing.
body:
This texture pack enhances the visuals in Minecraft by making important items more noticeable in the world. The Enchanted Golden Apple and the Breeze Rod are modified to appear about 4 times larger than normal when lying on the ground, making them much easier to spot during gameplay. In addition, these items have a slightly tilted angle when dropped, giving them a more natural and dynamic look.

This pack is perfect for players who want better item visibility and a more cinematic feel in their Minecraft world.
